predeclaredReading.betterIs: The checkpoint arm is read as better only if it passes STRICTLY MORE than 21 of the 30 predeclared tasks (the reference's count). A tie is not a gain and a loss is a loss; the reference is never re-measured to manufacture a fairer comparison.
predeclaredReading.whyStrict: Every arm of this program has carried a real verdict in all 30 cells, so the completion tie-break cannot decide anything: only the pass count and the per-cell flips can.
predeclaredReading.affectedCells: The clause can only act on work that ends in a value or a file the task reads back. The project's own records name terminal-bench/db-wal-recovery and gcode-to-text as the graded read-back cells, and both sit in the disclosed overlap set, so a pass-count win here would be a reading about such cells on this corpus, never a general capability claim. The other cells remain in the reading because a prompt edit can also cost them — the 2.19.0 reading lost four cells that the control passed.
predeclaredReading.completion: Completion is read per arm as cells with a real graded verdict versus cells left without one (error / not-evaluated / pre-model environment failure / provider transport failure); a verdict-less cell is a binding failure, never a capability loss.
predeclaredReading.score: Score is not used as a bar (retired as uninformative in the 2026-10-05 study); the discriminating readings are the pass count, the datacurve fail-to-pass fraction and the per-cell flips.
predeclaredReading.delivery: On the two graded read-back cells presence and first-write time are read exactly as before. In the 2.19.0 study the db-wal destination was delivered and passed for the first time (138.6 s of 900 s); gcode's destination has still never been written by any arm.
predeclaredReading.cost: Any cell whose disposition or failing set regresses against the reference is recorded as cost even if the count moves forward.
predeclaredReading.censoring: A cell bounded by its budget or a declared stop is a right-censored observation reported with its span: never excluded, never counted as a gain.
predeclaredReading.uncertainty: One attempt per cell; the checkpoint arm runs in a later window than the reference, so the comparison carries window difference exactly as every earlier study in this program did. Cells of this corpus have flipped between windows with no prompt change (db-wal itself read 0/7 and 5/7 for the same control text), so a one-cell net difference is not separable from run variance. Nothing here is an effect size.

fairnessDisclosures: No user prefix, no task-specific hint, no grader output and no evaluator feedback reaches the arm; against 2.19.0 the delta is the rewritten landing line, and against main it is the preservation sentence plus that line.

The added text names no task, file, path, value, tool alias, evaluator or grader; it is ASCII-only and states generic discipline; the six forbidden host-mechanism names are absent and enforced by the pinned negative loop.
One attempt per cell; no best-of-N, no retry-until-pass, no cell exclusion, no latency threshold, no cell dropped for being slow.
The reference arm is NOT re-dispatched: its number comes from its own earlier run, and that window difference is disclosed rather than hidden.
Task environments are internet-connected as frozen (no closed-book claim); any cell with an upstream-fetch signature is recorded, never credited as a delivery or pass mechanism.
The arm refs are never moved after dispatch; nothing is merged by this study alone, and no verdict of any earlier study is reinterpreted.

2.20.0's landing line reads: when the task reads back a value or a file you produce, land your answer the moment your reasoning supports it, even while it is still rough: write it straight to the required destination - never through a script you have not run, and before any further verification, decoding, cleanup or exploration, and never leave that destination empty while you keep analysing - and only then keep improving it there; a landed answer is a checkpoint, not a finish, and landing early never licenses a guess or a placeholder or finalizing a source change before its verification.
